latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — practical guidance for reading weather and staying safe outdoors without digital tools.

- Learn to identify 5 key cloud types and what they signal for upcoming weather.
- Use wind direction and speed to predict approaching changes.
- Recognize environmental signs of rising or falling barometric pressure.
- Designed for anyone working or spending time outdoors, especially where phone/weather apps are unavailable.
- Localization guidance for regional units and weather patterns included.
